blocks.raw: The Zalo template needs to be approved and whitelisted by Zalo. This approval process is handled by the Capillary Gateway team/vendor. You can filter the Zalo templates in the Creatives by their status.

blocks.raw: To use a uploaded template perform the following steps below:
blocks.text: To use a uploaded template perform the following steps below:

blocks.raw:
1. From the **Engage+** homepage, navigate to the Creative section and select **Zalo** as the engagement channel.
2. On the Zalo listing page, you can view the uploaded templates. Based on your needs, navigate to a Zalo template and select **Overview**.
3. A modal appears where you can edit the Zalo template. However, you can update only the variable portion of the template.
4. You can replace variables with static text or <Anchor label="labels" target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/labels">labels</Anchor>. Each variable field `({#var#})` supports a maximum of 50 characters. If a label resolves to more than 50 characters, the message is not sent and is skipped for that user.
5. On the right side of the modal, select **Open Preview**. You are redirected to a tab where you can preview the Zalo content.
